_note: Every threshold that bounds a map change (ADR 0003). The engine (engine/kta-engine.js) and the independent Python check (server/kta_server/mapcheck.py) both read their limits from this file: they share the numbers, never the code. Each entry carries value, unit, basis (measured = this car's data or its map file; source = a primary source read in full; judgement = our choice) and source (fact-check.md section, the log, or the map file it came from). A threshold change is a data change, reviewed like code.

boost_step_max.source: fact-check.md §4 (wastegate 2.5 % median at 15 psi and up: the turbo is near its limit, so boost moves in small steps)
boost_step_max.note: No single cell moves more than 1 psi in one Flash.

boost_raise_min_rpm.source: fact-check.md §5 (LSPI band 1,500–2,500 rpm at high load) and §2 (the map carries ~11° retard at 1,500 rpm / −1 psi: the lugging zone is knock-prone)
boost_raise_min_rpm.note: Below 3,000 rpm boost may only be lowered, never raised.

boost_ceiling_psi.source: ticket 06 D1 (the app writes up to the active map's Final Boost Target peak, 23.4 on Starter 21) and ticket 13 (24 psi: the highest any vendor file has run on this car); ADR 0007
boost_ceiling_psi.note: A rule, not a fixed number: no boost cell above the active map's Final Boost Target peak at that cell's rpm row (the lower of the two rows either side), and never above 24 psi. Each +1 psi is proven by datalog (boost_step_gates).

boost_step_gates.unit: mixed (%, s, rpm, psi, score, AFR, deg)
boost_step_gates.source: ticket 16 (proof pull: pedal 85 % held 4 s above 3,500 rpm, 2 pulls, rows 3,500-4,500; the pass gates), ticket 13 (overshoot tightened to 1.5 and target + overshoot 24; ignition achieved vs the last proven Map version, drop over 1°; DIFP 90 %; Knock Control 0.56 kept, read settled), ticket 17 (the logged target must reach the table: within 0.5 psi), ticket 06 D1 (undershoot 1.5, AFR never leaner than 12.0, trims ±5 %), ktuner-community-knowledge.md §6.5 (overshoot judged held 0.5 s: KTuner calls a 1-3 psi spike normal)
boost_step_gates.note: A Boost step is offered, and kept, only when every gate passes on the latest Cool drive's proof pulls and the latest hot drive's Knock Control. No Honda tuner publishes these numbers: they are our judgement on the shared tuner method (ticket 13).

maf_step_max_pct.source: fact-check.md §6 (cruise trims within ±5 % are OK, beyond ±10 % is a Stop: one round stays inside the healthy band)
maf_step_max_pct.note: No MAF Scaling point moves more than ±10 % per round.

maf_curve_rising.source: data/ktuner-maps-digitized.json (all four MAF Scaling curves rise at every point; test/engine.test.js asserts it)
maf_curve_rising.note: After the change the MAF Scaling curve must still rise at every point.

wot_target_band.source: fact-check.md §6 (the map file: WOT_Enrich top load columns ask 11.0, λ 0.75, at full load)
wot_target_band.note: WOT targets stay inside 11.0–12.0 AFR on the gasoline scale.

boost_pairs.source: engine P6 (engine/kta-car.js carFlashPlan: the six Normal boost tables move together, verified in the file); ticket 16 (a Boost step is written to Tune 2 only, a proven step is copied to Tunes 1 and 3; safety trims write all three tunes)
boost_pairs.note: A boost change touches, with identical cells, either all six tables (safety trims), Tune 2 L and H alone (a Boost step) or Tunes 1 and 3 L and H (promote). A raise in Tune 1 or 3 is accepted only as a promote: each cell's after equals the current Tune 2 cell.

wot_pairs.source: engine P6 (engine/kta-car.js carFlashPlan: WOT L=H, verified in the file)
wot_pairs.note: A mixture change touches both WOT tables with identical cells, or neither.

editable_tables.source: engine KTA.TABLES (only role=edit tables ship in a Flash; test/thresholds.test.js asserts the two lists match)
editable_tables.note: The only tables a Flash may touch, each with its one family.

forbidden_tables.source: fact-check.md §2 (timing = table + limitation − retard; the remedy is never desensitize the knock sensors) and engine KTA.TABLES roles leave/never/check/preset/info
forbidden_tables.note: Ignition, knock-sensitivity and protection tables never appear in a change; neither does any other table the basic stage leaves alone.

one_family_per_flash.source: engine P4 (engine/kta-car.js carFlashPlan: one table family per Flash, the rest wait to be proven)
one_family_per_flash.note: Every table in a change belongs to one family: AFM Flow, boost or mixture.
